case_description: Row count: how many log rows load from data/usage-logs.csv
rubric: Count rows in usage_logs after loading the CSV; must equal the number of data rows in the file (24).

case_description: Total AI cost: sum of cost_usd across all runs
rubric: SUM(cost_usd) rounded to 4 decimals; hand-checked against the CSV column total.

case_description: Total prompt tokens: sum of prompt_tokens
rubric: SUM(prompt_tokens); hand-checked against the CSV column total.

case_description: Total completion tokens: sum of completion_tokens
rubric: SUM(completion_tokens); hand-checked against the CSV column total.

case_description: Average cost per run: total cost divided by 24 runs
rubric: AVG(cost_usd) rounded to 4 decimals; must equal 3.8946 / 24 = 0.1623.

case_description: Helpful rate: share of runs users marked helpful
Reconciliation use case: run count and total cost
rubric: COUNT(*) and SUM(cost_usd) filtered to use_case = 'reconciliation'.

case_description: Cost tracing check: every row cost_usd equals round((prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) * model rate, 4)
rubric: Recompute each row cost from its tokens and its model rate (standard 0.00005, large 0.00012 per token); count rows that do not match. Any mismatch means the log cannot be trusted.

case_description: ROI ratio: (estimated savings - total cost) / total cost, where estimated savings = 20 helpful runs x $15.00
rubric: (20 x 15.00 - 3.8946) / 3.8946 = 76.03 (2 decimals). The $15.00 per helpful run is the stated invented assumption, not a measured fact.

case_description: Distinct users: how many different user_ids appear
Slowest run: maximum latency and which run it was
rubric: MAX(latency_ms) and the run_id that has it; a trace must point at one real run.
